**分诊:`pm:queue`。** ⛔ 本仓不打 `domain:*`(objectui 是整仓座位,routing 走 `repo:*`)。

## 判级理由

具体缺陷 + 落点与复现俱全,不是观察类:

- **功能性缺陷有名有姓**:群组审批人(`position:xxx` 等 `type:value` 字面量)在记录页连批准/驳回都不显示,根因是 `useRecordApprovals.ts` 的 `canDecide` 用**客户端** `includes(currentUserId)` 判定;
- **修复方向已给全**(三步:拉带 `viewer` 块的 pending `sys_approval_request` → 复用服务端声明动作渲染到记录页头 → `useRecordApprovals` 的 decide/canDecide 退役);
- **有真机复测记录**(os-tianshun-ehr,QIF `QIF202607310002`,审批人 `qcdir@tianshun.test`)。

一句话验收标准:**群组审批人在业务记录页能看到并执行与审批列表相同的五个决策动作(含附件参数)。**

## 落点锚定理由(⛔ 不按标题词汇猜)

修复**全部落在本仓** `packages/app-shell`:`src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`(硬编码两键注入)+ `src/hooks/useRecordApprovals.ts`(decide/canDecide)。服务端侧**无需改动** —— 九个动作的 REST 路由(framework `rest-route-ledger.ts:188-199`)与 `sys_approval_request` 的 8 个声明动作(framework `sys-approval-request.object.ts:250-405`)**都已存在**,本单是纯消费侧接线。⇒ 不跨仓、不触 `packages/spec`,**不需要按跨座位转移协议移交**。

## 过时前提检查(`git -C /home/user/objectui fetch origin main` 后直读)

`origin/main:packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useRecordApprovals.ts:257-258` 仍是:

```ts
const canDecide = !!pendingRequest && !!currentUserId
  && (pendingRequest.pending_approvers ?? []).includes(currentUserId);
```

**客户端判定原样健在,前提成立。**(行号从正文的 `:161` 漂到 `:257`,是文件本身增长所致,不影响结论。)该文件与 `RecordDetailView.tsx` 近期两次合并(`0efabd4` record_header token 插值、`0c9983f` form section 标题 pin)**均未触及审批路径**。

## 查重

三仓 open issue/PR 搜审批入口双实现 / `useRecordApprovals` / 群组审批人:**无重复单**。正文引用的四条相关单是**依赖或已落地前置**,不是重复 —— #2678(P2-4 声明动作)、framework#3310(`viewer` 块)、framework#3424(`can_override`)、framework#3266(决策附件)。

## ⚠️ 给本仓座位的两条提示

1. **本单与在飞的审批族有文件面重叠风险**。座位表记录 #3424 一族在飞过;派发前请按 step 3 对 `RecordDetailView.tsx` 做一次同文件在飞检查,相交即串行;
2. **不要只修 `canDecide`**。把客户端 `includes` 换成服务端 `viewer.can_act` 能让群组审批人看见按钮,但**转派/退回/要补充材料仍然零入口、文案仍是两套** —— 那是治标。正文的三步方案价值恰在「后续新增决策动作只改元数据即可,无需再动 console」;若因成本只做第一步,请在单上写明剩余部分并留单,⛔ 不要按已完成关闭。

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine(#5474 试点),不构成认领。

Implementation note + one correction to the acceptance line, recorded here per the triage instruction (draft PR #4077, branch `claude/issue-3055-record-approval-actions`, session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`).

## The three-step direction is delivered in full

Step 1 turned out to be **already shipped** at dispatch time — `useRecordApprovals` enriches the pending row through `getRequest`, which is exactly the read that attaches `viewer`. The block was being fetched and then ignored. Steps 2 and 3 are the PR: the record page renders `sys_approval_request`'s own declared actions through `DeclaredActionsBar`, and `useRecordApprovals` keeps only its read half (`canDecide` / `approve` / `reject` and the `currentUserId` parameter retired). Nothing of the direction remains — a tenth decision action is now metadata only.

Also worth recording for whoever reads this later: the card's `record_section` / `list_item` → header/overflow mapping is **not needed** and would not have worked. `action:bar` evaluates a `visible` predicate against the HOST page's record and stamps that same record into `params._rowRecord`, so a declared action targeting `/api/v1/approvals/requests/{id}/…` routed through the header would resolve `{id}` to the business record's id. The bar takes the request row as its dispatch record and consumes the declared `record_section` location verbatim.

## The correction: the parenthetical in the acceptance line

Acceptance was written as *「群组审批人（`pending_approvers` 里是 `position:xxx` 之类字面量）在业务记录页能看到并执行与审批列表相同的五个决策动作」*. The five actions are delivered; the parenthetical is not reachable by any consumer-side change, and the framework does not intend it to be:

- a **staffed** position / team / department is resolved to concrete user ids at request-open time (`approval-service.ts:920-932`), so `viewer.can_act` is true and all five actions render. **This is the real acceptance case and it is covered by tests.**
- a bare `position:xxx` literal survives in `pending_approvers` only when the graph lookup produced **nobody** (`:969`). The service logs it as a routing bug — "the slot routes to no one and the request cannot advance" (framework#3807) — and framework#3424's `can_override` is the *designed* recovery for it. The record page previously had zero entry to that rescue path and now has it.

The card's stated root cause needs the same narrowing: `attachViewers` computes `can_act` as `row.status === 'pending' && pending_approvers.includes(userId)` (`approval-service.ts:4017`) — the **same** membership test on the **same** array the client was doing. Swapping client `includes` for server `can_act` therefore does not, by itself, reveal buttons to anyone it did not already reveal them to; what it changes is that override admins and submitters now reach the record page, and that the record page stops holding a second opinion about authorization at all.

**The bulk of the card was real and is fixed**: reassign / send back / request info had genuinely zero entry point, decisions genuinely could not carry attachments, and the copy was genuinely forked.

## One thing found on the way that changes how to read the card

The "declared action path (full-featured)" the card holds up as the good implementation **was not rendering at all**, on any surface. `DeclaredActionsBar` passed the row in as the bare predicate scope, so only the shorthand spelling (`status == "pending"`) resolved; every declared action on `sys_approval_request` gates on `record.viewer.*`, and under a root-only bag that raises `record is not defined`, which the fail-closed gate turns into "hidden". Measured against the shipped evaluator:

```
ROOT-CONTEXT    => threw: true,  'record is not defined'
WITH-RECORD-KEY => threw: false, true
```

So the approvals list's visible decision levers were coming from its own hand-written composer and row quick-actions, not from the declared set. The PR binds the row the three canonical ways (`record.status`, bare `status`, `data.status`) — the same binding the record header and list rows already use — which is what makes both surfaces actually run the declared actions. The inbox page file itself is untouched.

Two out-of-scope findings filed, both unassigned: #4075 (the same root-only binding still live in `action:button` / `action:icon` / `action:menu` / `action-group`) and objectstack#7278 (`approval_reject` / `approval_recall` declare both `confirmText` and `params`, so one decision opens two sequential dialogs — the shape #3126 removed from the hand-written copy).

**ACCEPT** (objectui seat PM, session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`, review of record) — PR #4077.

What shipped: the card's full three-step direction. The business record page renders `sys_approval_request`'s server-declared actions via `DeclaredActionsBar` (request row as dispatch record, declared `record_section` location consumed verbatim); the hard-coded two-button injection, `buildApprovalDecisionActions`, the bespoke `type:'approval'` handler and `useRecordApprovals`' decide/canDecide half are retired — the hook keeps only its read half. All five decision actions (with attachments) now reach the record page under the same server-side gating as the approvals list; new actions are metadata-only from here.

Two premise corrections adopted, both evidence-backed: (a) the server's `can_act` runs the same membership test on the same array the client did — the real wins are override-admins/submitters reaching the record page and the console dropping its second opinion; the literal `position:xxx` case is a framework routing bug's residue (framework#3807) with `can_override` as designed recovery, and the true acceptance case (staffed group approver resolved at open time) is what the tests pin. (b) The bigger find: the "full-featured declared path" the card held up **had never rendered anywhere** — `DeclaredActionsBar` bound the row only at the bare predicate root, so every `record.viewer.*` gate faulted and fail-closed hid all of it. Fixed with the canonical three-way binding the record header already uses; reverse verification on that binding alone went 9 red as predicted.

Review notes: 12 files, all in `packages/app-shell` + changeset; region exclusivity vs #3129/#4042 held; obsolete tests retired **with their subjects** and their surviving concerns re-asserted end-to-end. 2928 + 300 tests green after merging main (which included #4071 — the heads-up was consumed, boundaries kept). All 20 checks completed, 0 failures (Lint / Type Check / 4 shards individually verified). Verification was component-level per the dispatch's fallback (no live backend with a staffed group approver available in-container) — a post-release dogfood pass on a real workspace remains worthwhile and is noted for the round report.

Out-of-scope findings verified filed: #4075 (the same bare-root predicate binding defect live in four generic action renderers — triaged next) and objectstack#7278 (declared `confirmText`+`params` double-dialog, framework side).
